title: Unsupported hearsay is marked as an Assumption

persona.name: Owen
persona.brief: Distinguish what you have observed from what you have only heard.

mission.objective: Learn whether opened packages are automatically rejected for return.
mission.desired_outcome: A supported return rule or a clearly unconfirmed assumption.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the finding before changing the returns flow.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Are opened packages automatically rejected for return?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: The return flow must not present an unconfirmed policy as fact.
investigation_results.relevant_context: No written policy was supplied to the Interview Session.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: Observed or documented policy supports the rule, or the unsupported inference is explicitly an Assumption.

turns.sourceQuestion: What happens when a customer returns an opened package?

answer.text: I assume we reject it because someone told me that when I started, but I have never handled one and I cannot find that rule in our guide.
